nom: PEACH & LILY Glass Skin Face Polisher

avis.texte: If you've experienced, oily skin that tends to breakout and pores that feel congested this product will help your skin tremendously. It makes you skin feel so smooth and helps your makeup go on seamlessly. It also makes your skin feel ready for a great night moisturizer.

One of the best products I've ever purchased. Makes my skin smooth and even-toned for days after using it in the shower. Highly recommend to improve skin texture and moisture. Also seems to have reduced my acne scars.

avis.titre: Pair this cleanser with the matcha pudding cream
avis.texte: When I was pregnant my skin felt flaky and dull so an employee at ulta recommended this to me I used the rice exfoliator morning and bedtime then I put on the matcha pudding face cream made my skin so much better my pores shrink even my sister commented my skin look clear and polished

avis.titre: love how my skin feels after using
avis.texte: I love how this makes my skin feel. I use it every evening, then follow with my regular routine. I have already purchased another one.
I am very pleased with the face polish. Very gentle but still exfoliating. Will repurchase.

This polishing scrub is such a wonderful gentle exfoliating addition to my cleanser regimen. You can titrate how strong the exfoliation is by adding more or less water to the powder. My skin feels noticeably smoother and glassy after using this!
Onto my second bottle and when I tell you lasts so long I'm NOT lying. This is the best rice cleanser on the market!!
Amazing product. One of my favs. My skin feels smooth but not irritated like most scrubs. I will definitely be buying this again
This product leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. Love how refreshing it is.

I have very sensitive skin, that usually can't tolerate chemical exfoliants, and even most physical ones are too harsh. This has been perfect. Sometimes I go too light and have to add a little extra powder to problem spots, but my skin feels and looks amazing after using this every other day for about a week before serum and moisturizer. I noticed a big difference after the first use and have continued to see improvements since.

avis.titre: I keep purchasing this gem again and again
avis.texte: I love this powder that turns into nice creamy lather or with a little less water it can be a nice scrub for a deeper clean. The bottle also gives the right amount of powder when you turn the bottle over into your hands giving you just enough powder to cleanse. It's perfect because you can't ever spill a ton of your product all over nor can you use too much or too little product than you need.

Admittedly, I have pretty good skin already, but occasionally I feel like the chemical exfoliants aren't cutting it. Every once in a while, I like to use a gentle physical one instead. This one works nicely. You shake out the powder, and depending on how much water is added, the exfoliation level changes. I don't necessarily notice a huge change in pore size or brightness afterwards, but my skin is smoother. I bought this on sale for 50% off though, and I definitely wouldn't have purchased this for any more than that.

Normally I was useing TreeHut face scrubs...but this product went on sale. I grabbed the last on in the store. It makes my skin feel so smooth and soft when I use it. I like that you can customize the amount of grit with the amount of water you add. Definitely will be repurchased in the future!

avis.titre: Glass skin polisher is a keeper!
avis.texte: I love this product! Gentle on the skin but you still feel like your getting clean! The packaging is nice too!

I love Peach & Lily brand! This face polisher serves as a gentle foaming exfoliant. Kinda reminds me of Tatcha Rice Polish but half the price & similar ingredients. Creates a nice foam and feels great on my skin.

avis.titre: Perfect for any day, any wash, any cleanse you're skin is lo
avis.texte: This is one face cleanser that has a huge range of different ways to approach skin cleansing. It comes out as a powder and if you can either add a little bit of water to get a good exfoliation cleansing. If you add a medium amount of water this powder will be a medium amount of exfoliation. Now if you just want to just wash your face gently but get down deep then adding a lot of water and mixing the powder together is perfect for that day.
Gentle exfoliation resulting in skin so smooth and flawless. I absolutely love it. I've told my sisters and friends to add this to their skin care routine!
Makes my face smooth, and I love the powder to foam design. Just add water, and voila! You can feel the little rice grains working to improve the texture of your skin.
My holy grail. Soft grain, gibbing my skin an even base for the rest of my routine and makeup application.
I love using this every day. I recommend putting it on your hand, then wet the other hand with hot water, then mix it together. My face always feels smoother after using.
I use it every day! It doesn't dry out my sensitive skin but exfoliates wonderfully.

I wanted to splurge on this cleanser because of the ingredients and the textual experience and I love how clean it makes my pores feel without irritation. It's a bit of a learning curve since I sometimes add too much water or too little, but it gets the job done, especially on my oily t zone

avis.titre: Not a good look for Peach & Lily.
avis.texte: I have been eyeing this product for a while now. I decided let's give it a go. I open the box to shake the product as directions say. I noticed it felt very light. So I hold the bottle up to the light and could clearly see the bottle wasn't full. Very disappointing. I did try it and my honest thoughts on this was not the best. It was a decent at exfoliating at best. I didn't notice much of a difference. Skin did not appear to be smoother or polished. The product is expensive. I've used far better products that are cheaper and better quality. This was the second Peach & Lilly product I bought that wasn't full. I will definitely be staying away from this brand. There are better options.
Absolute one of my favorite P&L products. So happy. New Face every morning. My go to product to feel immediately fresh faced. Thank you.
I love this product, I use it every day, morning and night. It is a nice, natural exfoliator. It does lather a bit too. It also lasts soooo long; I think I buy 1-2 bottles of it a year.
I like how fine this powder is! Cleans well and I am only using once a week to prevent dryness.
I really like this one. The texture of my skin is so smooth after and looks very clear. The results are great.
Got to try this in my Ulta 24 days of beauty Advent calendar. Obsessed!!! My mature skin feels so soft.
This is a great product. It is excellent at getting the makeup off without feeling like you are losing a few layers of skin.

I was driven to choose Peach and Lily after my old skincare brand was discontinued (a tragedy). It has vastly exceeded my expectations. This product came highly recommended and it is so gentle and good at exfoliation. Through using a Peach and Lily regimen I've seen great results and even convinced my mom (a LONG time Mary Kay user) to switch as well. I love this brand!
I absolutely love this exfoliant! It leaves your skin smooth and hydrating! 10/10!!

I was initially skeptical of an exfoliant I had to mix myself, but after trying this face polisher, I love it. You can adjust the intensity of the exfoliation in the palm of your hand and it leaves my skin smooth and clean. The container is very easy to use on the counter or in the shower. I will continue to use this face polisher.

avis.titre: my face is soft as a baby's bottom!
avis.texte: this product scrubs the skin so well and leaves it feeling soooo soft! I switched over from exuviance and this is much cheaper and actually works!

This face polisher is so gentle on my skin. I really love it. I originally had just the small sample but after using it I wanted the large one. Now I have this in all my homes as well as the Glass skin serum.
I love how soft this makes my skin feel! Helps with breakouts too. I mix it with the cleanser, perfect!
it works very well my face felt free of any dead skin and very smooth after
A nice gentle exfoliant to help soften skin texture gently. It does feel as if it's a polisher for my face. Thank you… I've been looking for a safe skin product like this.
This product is perfect and makes my skin feel so smooth. It isn't too harsh and is gentle enough to use daily.
I received this as a trial and absolutely fell in love with it. Natural ingredients. Leaves my face soft and refreshed all day long.

avis.titre: Peach & Lily Glass Skin Face Polisher
avis.texte: I like all of Peach & Lily's products. The Skin polisher is no exception. I do try to buy their products when they are on sale as they are a little pricey but they are worth it to me.

My skincare routine was decent but lacking. I stumbled upon Peach and Lily, and with their recommendation I purchased this exfoliator. Im ecstatic because my skin instantly reacted positively to it. I have acne prone skin that clogs easily. I believe the exfoliant rice and salicylic acid combo was exactly what my skin needed. Paired with the glass serum , the combo have made it to my HG list.

Purchased during Ulta's annual 21-day sale. It's one of my favorite new finds. Lathers easily and leaves my skin clean without feeling dry. I have extremely sensitive skin and struggle to find/try new products that work. I've been using this daily for over a month and my 45yo dry-to-combo skin takes it well without issue.

It's a nice consistency depending on how much water you have in your hands to mix the powder with. I always referred to the directions. However, after a month of using this product. It completely broke my face out in all areas. It left me with litte bumps and made my face itch. I would wash my face day/night with this. I experienced a glow but what's the use of that! I have never experienced this with a cleanser! I returned it, but I didn't get my money back and I got a store credit for it. 1000% DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!

avis.titre: My fav peach and lily exfoliator
avis.texte: I have used the rice srcub and this one and I def prefer this one. Gentle and efficient.
This exfoliator leaves my face radiant. I appreciate its simplicity and ease of use.
This is the only exfoliating scrub I use. It's so gentle. for my sensitive, combo skin, and it always feels so smooth after using it. My face couldn't be happier when I use this product

What I love about this polisher is that it is so gentle. I feel harsh crystals tearing at my skin when I use it. It also makes my skin feel so smooth and soft. I was looking for a scrub, but I found a polisher that does the job of a scrub with the gentleness as of a cleanser.
I love how my skin feels after using this. I use it every other night and have noticed less blackheads and less dry patches.

I love this powder. It cleans very well and exfoliates, gently enough to not cause any irritation. My skin is super smooth after using it. It should last a while since the bottle is big. Will definitely buy again.

Unless I read this wrong and it is not an exfoliator, which is what I bought it for, this is a lovely, moisturizing cleanser with gentle scrub balls, but it is not a polisher. Being someone who has rough skin as my base, a buff and puff exfoliator does not work on me. If you have creamy skin, this may work great for you.
This is my second time buying this product. It is very effective and it lasts long time.
This is the first time I like a mechanical exfoliator. It's really gentle, doesn't irritate my skin at all, and leaves my face baby-soft. Love it !
love this product, I use it every other day and it really gets rid of the black heads and smoothies my skin, and Its not hard on my skin.

avis.titre: One of my favorite products from Peach & Lily!
avis.texte: I got a mini of this in a P&L kit and loved it so much I bought a full size, which will probably last me forever. Sometimes I need some physical exfoliating, but not too harsh and not too often -- this rice polish is perfect on my older thin skin. It's very gentle yet I notice improvement. Just get it, or get the kit with the mini!

good exfoliator i would only say the container sometimes makes the powder come out too fast but i hqve noticed much softer skin with regular use and its gentle enough that i dont get tears or breakout as a result

This is the best facial exfoliant I have ever used. I love the whole glass skin line. My 52 year old skin has never looked better! I used to struggle with redness, enlarged pores, and dark spots. I still have a bit of redness occasionally, but very little. My dark spots are there, but much lighter now. Peach & Lily glass skin collection plus their matcha pudding cream are my go to skin products now.

avis.titre: Bought it, tried it, it's now a staple
avis.texte: I am a Korean skincare lover and one of my favorite parts is how clean my skin is after the cleansing. I put this as step 3 (step 1 - DHC deep cleansing oil; step 2: Peach and Lily deep cleansing foam), and my skin feels super clean, prepped and ready to absorb the actives from the rest of my routine. Great part of a glass skin routine!
As I am getting older my skin is changing and this face polisher gives my skin a clean fresh look and feel
Amazing product, good for sensity skin. Leaves the skin smooth and shinny. Highly recommend it

I'm new to Peach and Lily as I live in the UK. I've tried quite a few products but this is one of my favourites so far. Having purchased far more expensive polishers before this is by far the smoothest, least harsh one I've tried and it does the job well. I just love using it.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and have definitely noticed a difference in the surface of my skin. It leaves my skin smoother and softer without being too harsh. Just a little bit does the trick and I don't use it every day - maybe 2-3 times a week.

I really like this product. All you need to do is pour a small amount of it into you palm and add water. It feels gentle enough on my face not to irritate it but also feels like it smooths my skin and cleans it without stripping it dry.
I love using this whenever I feel my face or neck are a little rough. It makes me feel extra clean and soft.
It comes in a large quantity. I like that it has two ways to use it, depending on your needs. I suggest wetting your hands first to add it; it's easier to manage.

I have very sensitive skin and have struggled with acne since I was a teen (I'm 27). I also struggle with having really dry patches of skin and then some oily areas as well. This exfoliator hasn't itritated my skin or caused any more acne to surface other than my isual breakouts. The reason why i live this product is because many exfoliators I've used have left my face feeling very dry and stripped of all my natural oils. It leaves my skin feeling slightly moisturized but not an excessive amount. I think this would be great for all skin types!

Ever since this product dropped a few years ago my skincare shelf has never been without it! It's SUCH an amazing physical exfoliant that's gentle yet effective. Something I also like to do is add a little bit to the gel cleanser in my hand and use it together as a scrubbing cleanser! So good. 💕
my face was really smooth and definitely polished after using, but it did make it feel tight once it was dry

avis.titre: Like it, but needs a pleasant frangrance!
avis.texte: Love the packaging, and the idea of using natural finely ground rice grains for polishing — which works beautifully — BUT wish it had a pleasant fragrance. Will be looking for a different product because of that.
Super gentle exfoliant. Makes my skin feel super soft and extra clean after washing, and I love that it's gentle enough to use every day!

avis.titre: This face polisher is a must have!
avis.texte: I cannot say enough about this glass skin face polisher! I use this after the water gel cleanser about 4x/week and OMG is it amazing! Leaves my skin feeling SO smooth and polished looking and feeling SO clean!! I will never use any other exfoliating product again! The best!

Love how this makes my skin feel, the name says everything. I use this several times a week and use the Rice Dough scrub twice a week for a deeper exfoliation. Great prep for the rest of my skin care routine.

Glass Skin Face Polisher is a great way to brighten the appearance of your skin by gently removing dead skin cells with dry granules you add water to make a great scrub. It leaves your skin looking fresh and renewed. I love it and think you will, too!

I love Peach and Lily's matcha pudding moisturizer, so I had high hopes for this. Unfortunately, all it did was cause even more acne even after around 3 months of usage. I used to have clear skin with just some clogged pores on my chin, but now I have zits and tiny bumps all over my chin.
It made my face feel soft and only have to use a small amount.
Completely broke me out after one use and smells horrible. It made me a bit nauseous to even hse it
The best exfoliation and safe to use daily! This helps me fight breakouts and keep flowing daily!

I've been using this product for over a year and love it. It is gentle enough to use on my sensitive skin every day but I tend to use it every other day. My face feels, clean and fresh without being overly dry after using. Highly recommend. The bottle lasts forever too which is a huge plus!
I got a facial at Ulta by Susan in Greenwood, SC. She used this product and I loved it. It has the rice in it like the Dermatologica. But is less expensive.
I love the smell of rice lol. It cleans my face without it being too harsh.
I can't use chemical exfoliators and gave this a try. Its a game changer and the step was missing. I use it a few times a week and will always keep it in my cabinet.
I had to order this to use along with the other products to add to my daily routine and I absolutely love it! Great results!

I've been using this every evening since last summer, and I think it's really helped keep my pores clear! I have combination (oily/normal) sensitive dehydrated (not dry) skin that's somewhat acne-prone (hormonally). Absolutely love this. A little bit goes a long way, so one bottle lasts me for 8-9 months.
Love the skin polisher! I use it every 3 days. I have dry, sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate my skin at all.
Leaves skin very smooth and non irritated. Would recommend this product for those with sensitive skin!
It makes my skin so soft, and it adds a nice glow I would totally buy it again.
One of the best facial cleaners I have ever used. After using, my face feels clean, soft and smooth.
I highly recommend this product as an esthetician!!! -leaves my face so soft without over exfoliation -gentle -use this daily or every other day -lasts forever!!!!
Gentle while still actually doing something. I love how clean my face feels after using this, especially when paired with the HydroBubble Deep Foam Cleanser!
It really does make my face smooth I love to use this before I do my makeup for a super nice clean base.

avis.titre: Easy to customize strength of this face polish
avis.texte: I love that I can customize this face polish. Some days I add a lot of water to make it a lighter, milky exfoliating wash and other days I add less water and make it more of a paste.

i have been using the dermalogica microfoliant for years, but i thought i would give this a try and it is amazing! the granules are slightly bigger than dermalogica, which i liked and makes my skin feel really clean and fresh. will definetly buy again!
Love how soft and clean my skin feels after using. It has a nice lather and doesn't leave my skin overly dry.
I was blown away by how much smoother my skin looked after using this. And it did not irritate my skin
Don't need a large amount of the polisher powder to exfoliate. Results are pretty quick, which was very exciting

I'm amazed by this cleanser. You can feel the difference before and after you use it. My chin is a problem area and is always congested. This cleanser effectively cleanses and smoothens it out. My go to cleanser was the Microdelivery face wash by Philosophy. Didnt think i could find better til i used this one. This is definitely my new go to cleanser!
The glass skin polisher is my favorite Peach & Lily product. Makes my skin feel incredibly clean and soft. Just repurchased.
this really changed my face forever it scrubs really nicely with the peach and lily oil it SHINESSS and takes out my black heads with I LOVEEEE

I wanted to really like this. It feels good going on and washing off. But I feel like the days I use this, my face gets a little more clogged or just doesn't feel as balanced as other days. Didn't hate it but I find myself not reaching for it often.
I switched to this scrub to avoid microplastics found in other face scrubs. The product dispenses as a powder, add a little water and polish away.
What a great product. Instant glow and smooth skin. Noticeable by EVERYONE!

I had dozens of blemishes/hives/some mysterious flood of acne or bug bites for over 1 month. This wash has been removing the debris that other face washes & scrubs weren't getting rid of!! After 2 months of bumps: my skin is smooth, thanks to this product + glycolic toners/exfoliating pads + benzoyl peroxide. I bought 3 more- can't live without this now

I'm a senior that hasn't taken care of skin until I was in my 60's. I didn't want to over exfoliate but decided to try this. Shocking how amazing! Skin looked great even the next morning. My skin didn't dry out, looked firmer, I use once a week but may increase to twice a week. This will be a staple.
This makes your skin so fresh and smooth!!! Definitely need as part of your routine!
Really love this unique scrub. Really smoothes the skin. Works!

This little polisher surprised me when it was a powder that came out and then it quickly turned into a lather. I use this as part of my routine every night to really refresh my skin. It makes my skin feel very refreshed and ready for the day.
